exercises.question: According to the text, when was Las venas abiertas de América Latina published?
Which sentence says "It worries me that they ban books"?

exercises.sentence: El hecho de que el libro se __ en varios países no cambia lo que dice.
exercises.english: The fact that the book was banned in several countries does not change what it says.

sentences: Eduardo Galeano nació en Montevideo en 1940. [Eduardo Galeano was born in Montevideo in 1940.]
Las venas abiertas de América Latina se publicó en 1971. [Las venas abiertas de América Latina was published in 1971.]
En los años setenta, varias dictaduras militares prohibieron el libro. [In the 1970s, several military dictatorships banned the book.]
Galeano murió en Montevideo en 2015. [Galeano died in Montevideo in 2015.]
